name: address-confirm-dialog
title: Address confirm dialog
description: A checkout dialog for an address that cannot be verified exactly: what was typed beside the suggestion, the differences in bold, to choose from or to edit.
docs: entered and suggested are lists of lines, { id, value }, in the order of your form; the id is the field a line comes from ('street', 'postalCode') and lines are matched across the two addresses by id. Within a line the words are compared, so only the words that differ are bold and a screen reader hears 'Changed' before each of them; a line only one address has is bold as a whole. reason says why the address could not be verified, and the sentence under it counts the lines that differ. The suggestion is chosen to begin with (defaultValue, or value with onValueChange). 'Use this address' calls onUseSuggested(suggested), or onKeepEntered(entered) when the typed address is chosen; return a promise and the button shows it is working, the dialog closes when it resolves and stays open when it rejects. 'Edit address' closes the dialog and, once it has closed, calls onEdit with the id of the first line that differs so you can focus that field; the dialog leaves focus to you then (without onEdit, focus goes back to where it was). allowKeep makes the typed address a second choice, 'Keep what I typed', and choosing it opens a warning that delivery may fail; without it the typed address is shown to compare and cannot be chosen. open, defaultOpen and onOpenChange control the dialog and trigger is the element that opens it (without one, focus goes back to where it was). On a short screen the content scrolls and the buttons stay in view. AddressConfirmPanel is the same content without the dialog, for a step in the page. address.ts exports compareAddresses for your own use. Always pass locale; labels holds every word. Nothing is sent anywhere by the component itself.
